theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e : Euclid P) (r₀ s : ℝ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P) (T : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (lam φ : ℝ → ℝ), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ u e = 0 → 0 < s → s < r₀ → IsOpen N → (∀ x ∈ N, 0 < inner ℝ x u) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < inner ℝ (γ α) u ∧ Real.arctan (inner ℝ (γ α) e / inner ℝ (γ α) u) = α) → (∀ t ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s), ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, t • γ α ∈ N ∧ T (t • γ α) = Submodule.span ℝ {γ α, deriv γ α}) → ContDiff ℝ 1 lam → HasCompactSupport lam → tsupport lam ⊆ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo (-s) s → ∃ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ N ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s), ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((T (t • γ α)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X (t • γ α)).toLinearMap) = lam t * deriv φ α * ((inner ℝ (γ α) u ^ 2 + inner ℝ (γ α) e ^ 2) / ‖deriv γ α‖ ^ 2)
